narrative.headline: Discover premium Japanese restaurants with source courses, release rules and honest availability states.
narrative.value_prop: Read-only public OMAKASE planning. Compare courses and cancellation terms, then use canonical booking links.
narrative.auth_narrative: Public discovery and detail need no account. Exact seats require login; Premium search and calendars remain gated. No paid account required by this CLI.
narrative.when_to_use: Use for OMAKASE restaurant discovery, public course details and release rules, or planning comparison. Exact seats and account eligibility are gated.
